notes.title: Lycoris Update
notes.notes:
The following functions have been improved.

1- A new map was added

2- All maps have been configured to be playable in all game modes.

3- Some changes in the Main Menu UI

4- A dynamic and easier UI was created for the Custom Map Mode, making it much easier to choose the Map you want to play.

5- New Visuals.

6- 3 new game modes have been added to Quick Match, which will be available soon along with a new UI which has already been integrated.

7- New Songs Maps.

8- Some maps have been optimized.



Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.

notes.title: Lycoris V2 Release
notes.notes:
LYCORIS just Release V2!

New Features - Whats New?


1-Loadout System

2-Primary/Secondary Weapon

3-Weapon attachments

4-Weapon Skins

5-Lethal equipment (Grenade/Claymore)

6-Perks

7-Field Upgrades (e.g., an ammo box or a medkit)

8-Lycoris Agents

9-Character Selection system.

10-New Rifle weapon added.

11-New Killstreak: Cluster Strike.

12-Procedural Aim Down Sights.

13-Level-up System.

14-Challenges/Missions System.

-15Tactical Sprint.

16-New Inspect weapon animations.

17-New Tactical sprint animations.

18-Assault Rifle animations reworked.

19-New VFX (like muzzle flashes, bullet tracers, explosions, etc.).

20-New Weapon sounds - using metasounds.

21- Toons of New Menus ( User Interface ).




Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.

notes.title: Lycoris Update
notes.notes:
The following functions have been improved.

1- The following maps have been optimized: MainMenu, Character Selection, OpenWorld
2- A new main menu has been added
3- The rifle's firing distance range has been improved, it was previously 2900, now it is 7000.
4- The pause menu has been improved

Together we will make Lycoris a better game.
Thank you for your patience and support towards (Lycoris). Att: MikiGames.
